language.title: Language
language.hint: Interface language (defaults to your system's). Some screens and daemon messages are still in French.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.hint: The bell always shows what's waiting for you. When Vigie has focus, a toast lets you know; otherwise, a system notification.
notify.blockedMac: System notifications are blocked: allow Vigie (“Electron” in dev) in System Settings › Notifications, or the site in your browser.
notify.blockedWindows: System notifications are blocked: allow your browser in Settings › System › Notifications, and the site in its settings.
notify.blockedOther: System notifications are blocked: allow Vigie (“Electron” in dev) in your desktop's notification settings, or the site in your browser.

waiting.title: Permissions and questions
waiting.hint: Always in the bell and as a toast. System notification when Vigie doesn't have focus:

turn.title: End of turn
turn.hint: Claude is done and hands back to you.

usage.title: Usage alerts
usage.hint: Toast or notification when a threshold is crossed (see below). The bell keeps them either way.

sound.title: Sound
sound.hint: A small chime: two notes for a request, one for an end of turn.

pause.title: Do not disturb
pause.idle: Mutes sound and system notifications for 1 h; the bell and toasts keep going.

locale.title: Terminal locale
locale.hintBefore: Encoding and language of the shell and claude (accents, symbols). Empty: automatic

alerts.title: Usage alerts
alerts.hint: An alert when today's estimated cost or the 5-hour window goes over your threshold: once a day for cost, once per window. Empty: no alert.
